sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by L.
Target: yourself. Recovers 5 Cost.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Wind elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Wind elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
